name: Summit AZ - Session Handoff 2026-10-01
body:
> Handoff · Summit Az · 2026-10-01

# Summary
Built from 114 Claude Code transcripts (May 18 to Sep 30, 2026) when old sessions were archived. It records the decisions still in force, the status of every workstream as of Sep 30, the pending list, recurring workflows, key file locations, IDs and footguns. Arizona only. Companion: [Session Handoff 2026-10-01 (All Clients)](lib:brain-session-handoff-2026-10-01-all-clients) and [Organization Log 2026-10-01](lib:brain-organization-log-2026-10-01).

# Status by workstream (Sep 30)
- Site: 202 live URLs (9 core, 30 service, 122 local = 12 services x 10 cities, 31 blogs, 10 other). GSC: 171 indexed, 14 not indexed. Site was rebuilt by Scott inside the Utah WordPress and pushed over AZ on Sep 3 (WPvivid), so leftover Utah IDs and wording are expected.
- Search Atlas Aug 28 to Sep 28: 34 clicks, 11.8K impressions, 1,468 ranking keywords, AI visibility 1.8%.
- Blogs: 31 live; B2 (softener sizing) and B4 (slab leak) not started.
- City pages: duplication with sister cities (not thinness) found to be the not-indexed cause on Sep 24; 18 pages rewritten Sep 24 to 26, plus 110 hub links and claim edits. See [Summit AZ - City Pages Index](lib:brain-summit-az-city-pages-index).
- Technical: Sep 30 audit clean (no broken links or chains). Keyword targeting audit found 17 cannibalization cases.
- Rank Math: 3 batches applied Sep 15 (29 titles, 91 keyword boxes, 122 descriptions). Local SEO business fields still empty at that time.
- OTTO: engaged, pixel off, about 1,993 inert queued fixes (219 unsafe). One Custom HTML deployment on /slow-drains/.
- GBP: hands off; about 517 reviews, 24 unreplied, unapproved services listed.
- Google Ads (140-101-3750): Navien Tankless, Branded Defense, Emergency Water Heater, LSA. Conversion fix still open.
- Tracking: GA4 AZ 459518259 via Site Kit; custom lead form posts to GHL, Keystone and email; `generate_lead` not yet verified.

# Pending (as of Oct 1)
- Scheduled checks: Oct 1 monthly case study, Oct 2 full review of Sep changes, about Oct 7 index re-check, Oct 10 and Oct 24 ranking checks.
- Waiting on Kim: emergency-search strategy (Tempe fix list), Conflicts sheet fixes, terms page consolidation, leftover noindex pages, unapproved claims still live, East Valley service-area line on 80 pages.
- Waiting on Scott: homepage title/keyword, Rank Math Local SEO details, /home-warranty-plumbing/, epoxy/CIPP, 0% financing, mu-plugin FAQ cache patch, Ads conversion fix, backlink vendor history.
- Content backlog: B2, B4, held Sep 17 audit items, remaining near-copy city families, AI visibility, media library alts, favicon safety net.

# Workflows recorded
- Access via `ssh summit` (SiteGround) and WP-CLI, table prefix `paf_`.
- Live edit routine: server backup, dry run with exact-match counts, apply, flush caches (`wp cache flush`, `wp sg purge`), verify with a cache buster, log in the change log and case study.
- Elementor rewrites mapped to widget IDs (Now vs New), ops JSON that refuses unless every op matches once.
- Blog publish routine, GSC Request Indexing via Kim's Chrome (quota varies 4 to 23 a day), page tracker refresh (`page-tracker\sync.py`), SEO visibility tracker refresh.

# Footguns
- Audit tools overstate; verify live. OTTO pixel or MetaSync on deploys every queued fix. WP-CLI posts get `_elementor_*` meta. Rank Math sitemap cache needs its own invalidation. Redirection plugin self-disables. SiteGround WAF 403s bots and no-trailing-slash URLs. Google Ads 1401013750 is Summit.
